title: 第29章 国产电影太需要我了
content_zh:
2003年年初的BJ，中国美术馆内光影静谧。

    谷川陪着刘小丽缓步在一幅幅画作之间，当刘小丽在一幅描绘芭蕾舞者旋转的油画前驻足时，谷川开口了。

    “刘姐，您看这幅画的光影，像不像谷崎润一郎笔下的‘阴翳礼赞’？”

    谷川看着画作侃侃而谈：“画家没有把一切都暴露在刺眼的强光下，而是懂得在阴影与留白中，去捕捉舞者肢体间那种‘迂回不直接，暧昧而不透明’的张力。

    真正的美，往往就藏在这些若即若离，需要人自行去琢磨的缝隙里。

    您能一眼看透这层‘阴翳’背后的灵魂，说明您骨子里就有着最顶级的东方古典审美。”

    刘小丽听得入神，眼神里满是惊喜。

    刘艺菲在旁边撇了撇嘴，“马屁精！”

    “嗯？”

    被刘小丽瞪了一眼之后，她站在旁边不吭声，但绝不认错。

    再怎么瞪，他也是马屁精。

    谷川笑容不变，就像是没听到刘艺菲的话一样。

    但也不能继续和刘小丽一起看下去了。

    他这次准备的并不充足，肚子里没有多少货了。

    再逛下去，他就只能自己编词了。

    但刘小丽脚下动作很快，还没等谷川说话呢，就到了另一幅画前。

    画布上是大片随意泼洒的色块，其间夹杂着几道凌厉而决绝的黑色线条，既混乱又似乎暗含着某种奇异的秩序。

    刘小丽微微蹙眉，显然对这种前卫的风格感到有些费解。

    谷川敏锐地捕捉到了她的神情，他上前半步：“刘姐，您是不是觉得这幅画看似狂乱，却隐隐有一种抓人的力量？

    其实，这幅画深得欧洲‘虚空派’大师埃米尔·梵卓晚期‘意识流构图’的精髓。”

    听到一个完全陌生的名字和流派，刘小丽愣了一下，随即更加专注地看向谷川。

    谷川神色自若地说着：“梵卓曾提出过一个绝妙的理论，叫做‘情绪的反刍’。

    他认为，真正的艺术不应该只是把美好的事物画得像照片一样完美，而是要像这幅画一样，故意打破完美的表象，用看似冲突的色块去还原人类内心最真实、最纠结的瞬间。”
content_en:
BJ in early 2003, the light and shadow in the National Art Museum of China were quiet.

    Tanichuan walked slowly between paintings with Liu Xiaoli. When Liu Xiaoli stopped in front of an oil painting depicting a ballet dancer spinning, Tanichuan spoke.

    "Sister Liu, do you think the light and shadow in this painting look like the 'Ode to Shadow' written by Junichiro Tanizaki?"

    Tanigawa looked at the painting and talked eloquently: "The painter did not expose everything to the dazzling bright light, but knew how to capture the 'circular, indirect, ambiguous and opaque' tension between the dancer's limbs in the shadows and blank spaces.

    True beauty is often hidden in these remote gaps that require people to ponder by themselves.

    You can see through the soul behind this layer of "gloom" at a glance, which means that you have the top oriental classical aesthetics in your heart. "

    Liu Xiaoli listened with rapt attention, her eyes full of surprise.

    Liu Yifei curled her lips next to her, "Flattery!"

    "Huh?"

    After being glared at by Liu Xiaoli, she stood aside and said nothing, but she would never admit her mistake.

    No matter how hard you glare, he is still a flatterer.

    Tanichuan's smile remained unchanged, as if he didn't hear Liu Yifei's words.

    But I can’t continue watching with Liu Xiaoli.

    He was not well prepared this time, and he didn't have much in his stomach.

    If he continues shopping, he will have to make up his own lyrics.

    But Liu Xiaoli moved very quickly, and before Tanichuan could speak, she arrived in front of another painting.

    The canvas is a large area of ​​randomly splashed color, interspersed with a few sharp and decisive black lines, which is both chaotic and seems to imply some strange order.

    Liu Xiaoli frowned slightly, obviously confused by this avant-garde style.

    Tanichuan keenly caught her expression, and he took a half step forward: "Sister Liu, do you think this painting looks crazy, but it has a vague power to catch people?

    In fact, this painting captures the essence of the late "stream of consciousness composition" of the European "voidist" master Emile Vanzoa. "

    Hearing a completely unfamiliar name and genre, Liu Xiaoli was stunned for a moment, and then looked at Tanichuan more intently.

    Tanichuan said calmly: "Vanzhuo once proposed a wonderful theory called 'emotional rumination'.

    He believes that real art should not just paint beautiful things as perfect as photos, but, like this painting, deliberately break the appearance of perfection and use seemingly conflicting color blocks to restore the most real and tangled moments in human hearts. "
title_en: Chapter 29 Domestic movies need me so much
